title: GET /api/projects/:id — get single project detail
description: Return detailed data for a single project including milestones, recent todos, and recent journal entries.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 404 if project not found or belongs to different user
Response includes project fields + milestones array + todos array

steps.details: Query projects WHERE id = req.params.id AND user_id = req.userId AND deleted_at IS NULL. If not found, return 404. Fetch milestones for the project. Fetch todos for the project. Return 200 with { ...project, milestones, todos }.

Create server/src/utils/projectOwnership.ts: async function getOwnedProject(projectId: string, userId: string): Promise<Project> — returns project or throws 404 AppError. Reuse this in all project-specific endpoints.
GET /api/projects/:id with valid id — verify full response. Try another user's project id — expect 404. Try non-existent id — expect 404.
